condition: With customParseFormat, parsing an unseparated string like '600' with the 'Hmm' format reads the single-digit hour greedily as '60', so the time comes out wrong (12:00 PM instead of 6:00 AM).
workaround: Zero-pad the input to four digits and parse it with 'HHmm' instead, e.g. dayjs('0600', 'HHmm').
